about_the_game:
Take charge as Ned Kelly, once Australia's most infamous outlaw and now one of the last lines of defence for souls drifting between Heaven and Earth. As an attorney for the dead, you will see their every sin laid bare at trial and prove with their whole life as evidence that they can be redeemed. Alongside your apprentice Azazel, a newly fallen angel, the secrets of Purgatory will be yours to unravel.

Set in 1918 at the tail end of the Great War, Outlawyer will take you on an adventure through the realm of Purgatory as you work to uncover mysteries and defend the dead from eternal damnation. Ned's work doesn't end in the courtroom, though; you'll brave the streets of the afterlife and the perils of others who fell short of Heaven just like you.

-Prove your opponents wrong in exhilarating trials that cross realms and challenge assumptions in the pursuit of salvation.

-Gorgeous and expressive hand drawn artwork for the entire game

-An original score that is both orchestral and otherworldly 

-Unique minigames in trials that get you ever closer to the truth

-Explore the dreary streets of Purgatory, a world where countless eras overlap.

-Discover and build bonds with historical icons dating back to antiquity.

-Gather all your deductive prowess to uncover not just your client's salvation, but the secrets of the afterlife lying just below the surface.

*All the characters depicted are fictional even if they are inspired by real historical and biblical figures. Any events that happen in game are fictional events for the story and may not reflect real life.

content_descriptors.notes: May contain violent depictions of deaths and murder as you review the lives of the deceased.

short_description: An upcoming visual novel set in Purgatory during World War 1. Take the role of Ned Kelly, former Australian outlaw turned lawyer, and the fallen angel Azazel, his partner and apprentice, as you help save souls from eternal damnation, while uncovering a mystery of biblical proportions!
